21st_magic_component_builder.rationale: The tool searches/uses `21st.dev (library for searching UI components)` and `ONLY returns the text snippet for that UI component`; component snippets from a public/third-party component library may be attacker-authored. The description does not state whether the 21st.dev corpus is curated or multi-writer, so UNTRUSTED is kept as undetermined. It does not advertise writing files itself (`After calling this tool, you must edit or add files`) and uses a fixed service rather than an agent-chosen host, so it is not labeled SINK or HOSTEXEC.

logo_search.rationale: The tool `Search and return logos` and can return `Component code` or `raw SVG markup`; logo data/code is public third-party content and may be attacker-controllable for attacker-owned brands or registries. The description does not settle whether the logo source is curated, so UNTRUSTED is kept as undetermined. It searches a fixed logo service/corpus and does not advertise posting to an agent-chosen destination, so it is not labeled SINK or HOSTEXEC.

21st_magic_component_inspiration.rationale: The tool can `fetch data and previews from 21st.dev` and returns `JSON data of matching components` / `text snippet`; public component data from a third-party component library may be attacker-authored. The description does not state whether 21st.dev content is curated or multi-writer, so UNTRUSTED is kept as undetermined. It does not advertise state changes or sending to an agent-chosen host, so it is not labeled SINK or HOSTEXEC.

21st_magic_component_refiner.rationale: The tool takes `absolutePathToRefiningFile` described as `Absolute path to the file that needs to be refined` and `returns redesigned version of the component`; if it reads that host file, the returned redesigned component may contain non-public local source. The description does not settle whether the server reads the path or only uses the supplied `context`, so SECRET is kept as undetermined. It does not advertise arbitrary execution or delivery to an agent-chosen destination, so it is not labeled HOSTEXEC or SINK.

notes: No tool output schemas were advertised; output fields are inferred only from the descriptions. Fixed vendor/service queries are treated as not SINK, although calls still send argument values out of the agent context for kind/value-argument purposes.
